name: menu-flags

description.en: What the menu claims (W-MR0 rows MR0 + MR4). (i) The owner-typed `popular` tag is shown as "Venue's pick" in sq/en/uk/ru; the data key stays `popular`, so old menus render. (ii) The owner's menu screen counts and lists the dishes with UNDECLARED allergens (no `allergens` array: absent is undeclared, [] is 'none of the 14'); with feature.allergen_filter on, the hub refuses a NEW dish asked on sale undeclared and an update that puts an undeclared dish on sale (409). (iii) The guest's `dw_avoid` filter hides a dish only on the guest's explicit chip; an inferred allergy only warns (FIC 1169/2011). (iv) 'Most ordered this week: N' is a 7-day count of portions over orders that took money (rejected/cancelled/refunded out), TEST orders (contact name LIVE-/FLOWS-) out, shown only from n >= threshold, with n printed, and equal to the analytics pane's weekTop for the same window (one fold, week_top::counts).
description.uk: Що каже меню: тег «Вибір закладу» замість «популярне», лічильник страв без заявлених алергенів, фільтр алергенів лише за вибором гостя, і чесне «найчастіше замовляють цього тижня: N» без тестових замовлень, рівне числу в аналітиці.

producer.what: counts(): the 7-day fold, took_money only, TEST orders counted apart
public(): the badged dishes only (n >= THRESHOLD, at most MAX_BADGES)
owner(): every dish, its test portions, badge flag -- the analytics pane's weekTop
update_product: available=true on an undeclared dish -> 409 while feature.allergen_filter is on
create_product: a new undeclared dish is held off sale; asked on sale -> 409

consumer.what: the storefront badge: fetch menu/week, draw 'Most ordered this week N' on each badged card
hiddenBecause(): only the guest's chosen allergens hide; undeclared hides only under an explicit choice
undeclaredPanel(): the count + list on the owner's menu screen
weekTopCard(): the analytics pane's card, the same numbers as the badge

external: Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 (FIC) Art. 9(1)(c), Art. 44 and Annex II: the 14 allergens a non-prepacked food must declare

product_request_schema.description: the subset of POST /api/owner/products/:id this feature uses

probe: tools/live-proof/probes/feature-menu-flags.mjs: on qa-durres, with feature.allergen_filter switched ON for the run (and restored), a QA dish LIVE-<run> is created off sale without allergens: the owner's product list counts it undeclared, putting it on sale is a 409, declaring ['fish'] lets it on sale and the storefront menu (?fresh=1) shows allergens ['fish'] on it; then N TEST orders of it are placed and ended: menu/week never shows it (TEST orders are out) and the analytics pane's weekTop shows test >= N and n unchanged for it; every badged dish's n on menu/week equals the pane's n. The dish is deleted at the end. A step that cannot run is FAILED, never skipped.
